result.summary: The main visual defect is horizontal overflow: content is clipped at the right edge rather than fitting within the mobile viewport. The page also has a lower restaurant card obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The horizontal category rail extends beyond the right edge, leaving a partially visible next category chip with no clear inset or scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the rail to the viewport with intentional horizontal scrolling, add appropriate end padding, and optionally show a clear scroll cue.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is clipped at the right edge; its restaurant name and delivery price are truncated (for example, “Trattoria Piccol…”).
issues.suggestion: Use a deliberately sized horizontal carousel with consistent card widths and spacing, or ensure clipped cards do not expose cut-off text outside their visible area.

issues.description: The next “Popular right now” restaurant card is covered by the fixed bottom navigation, so its content cannot be fully viewed or interacted with while at this scroll position.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the navigation height (including safe-area inset) so the final visible card clears the fixed navigation.
